faqs.q: How long should a Bumble bio be?
faqs.a: Short enough to read in a few seconds, usually two to four sentences. Use that space for one specific hook, a line about what you genuinely enjoy and an easy question someone can reply to, rather than a long list of hobbies or requirements.

faqs.q: Can I write my Bumble bio in Hindi or Hinglish?
faqs.a: Yes, you can write your bio in the language you are most comfortable with, and a little Hinglish can feel natural and friendly if that is how you actually talk. Keep it easy to read for the people you hope to match with, and avoid slang or in-jokes that only a few would understand.

faqs.q: Is it a good idea to have a funny Bumble bio?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the humour sounds like you. A light, specific joke about your own interests works better than overused lines such as fluent in sarcasm, and too much self-deprecating humour can come across as low confidence, so balance it with something sincere about yourself.

faqs.q: How often should I change my Bumble bio?
faqs.a: Give each version of your bio about a week before judging it, and change only one part at a time, such as the opening line or the closing question. Compare your matches and the quality of conversations between versions, and keep the one that leads to better chats.
